description: US-based bare-metal GPU infrastructure provider whose hosted inference routes are publicly exposed through OpenRouter.
residency_notes: OpenRouter's live provider registry lists Ionstream headquarters and datacenters in the United States and classifies its endpoints as zero-data-retention. No customer-selectable region is published.
prompt_training_notes: OpenRouter's provider directory marks Ionstream as not training on prompts and as zero-data-retention.
regional_pricing_notes: OpenRouter publishes the Ionstream endpoint's effective USD token prices; no regional variation is exposed.

sources.notes: Live provider metadata including Ionstream's US headquarters/datacenters and official legal links.
Live Ionstream-hosted model catalogue; one model was available at audit time.
Machine-readable endpoint limits, quantization, supported parameters, availability, and effective pricing.

verification.notes: Reconciled against Ionstream's legal pages and OpenRouter's live provider, model, and endpoint APIs. Ionstream currently hosts one public inference route; direct Phaseo routing remains disabled.
